exclusions.source_text: Patients 1 - 30 years of age at the time of enrollment are eligible for this study.
Patients must demonstrate adequate performance level as measured by Karnofsky ≥ 70% for patients aged 16 years or older, OR Lansky ≥ 70% for patients younger than 16 years.
Adequate renal function as defined as EITHER of the following:
exclusions.threshold: Radioisotope GFR ≥ 70ml/min/1.73 m2 or age/sex-based serum creatinine maximum

exclusions.source_text: Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 x ULN for age\*
exclusions.threshold: Total bilirubin > 1.5 x ULN for age

exclusions.source_text: ALT ≤ 3.0 x ULN for age (≤ 135 U/L). For the purpose of this study, the ULN for ALT is 45 U/L
Adequate cardiac function measured by echocardiogram as defined as EITHER of the following:
participants with potential to become pregnant or to impregnate a partner must agree to use adequate contraception
Pregnant or currently breast feeding: Pregnant participants are excluded from this study
Untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastatic disease
Clinically significant arrhythmias, i.e. those that cause clinical symptoms or require medications for control of symptoms
